name: Coffee Pub Curator
tagline: Token art matching, dead-token swaps and lootable corpses.
description: Builds a searchable artwork cache, then matches token, portrait and tile images with adjustable weighting. When creatures die it swaps in dead-token visuals and offers a multiplayer loot window with generated loot.
pitch: Match token and portrait art automatically, swap defeated creatures to dead-token art, and turn bodies into lootable corpses your players can search.

features.title: Token art matching
features.text: Replaces token and portrait images using file names and paths, weighted by actor name, folders and tags.

features.title: Batch re-matching
features.text: Batch tools re-match tokens or portraits on the current canvas.

features.title: Dead token swaps
features.text: Swaps to a dead image at 0 HP, separate for PCs and NPCs, and restores original art on revival.

features.title: Loot generation
features.text: Loot tables (general, supplies, treasure, epic) with configurable coin and epic-roll chance.

features.title: Lootable bodies
features.text: Double-click a body to take items, give to party members, distribute coin, loot all, or bury it.

features.title: GM loot controls
features.text: Edit quantities, remove items, open the corpse sheet; settings for proximity and looting in combat.

steps: Install Coffee Pub Blacksmith and Curator, then enable both in your world's module settings.
Choose Images (art matching) or Death and looting (dead art plus loot); configure in Module Settings, Coffee Pub Curator.
Images: use the Curator menubar button, Replace Token, then apply a ranked match. Looting: take an NPC to 0 HP, wait for conversion, double-click the body.
